veranderings.voor: Gras lewe in die oop veld en die springbok
veranderings.na: Gras lewe in die oop veld, en die springbok
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Daar is baie soorte habitat en hulle
veranderings.na: Daar is baie soorte habitatte, en hulle
veranderings.rede: After 'baie soorte' Afrikaans uses the plural noun (as the next sentence does), and the AWS comma goes before 'en' joining two clauses.

veranderings.voor: op die land en ander is in die water
veranderings.na: op die land, en ander is in die water
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb, matching the previous sentence.

veranderings.voor: vol hoë bome en die skaduwee
veranderings.na: vol hoë bome, en die skaduwee
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
'Varswater' (fresh water as a kind of water) is written as one word in the AWS.

veranderings.voor: lewe in die water en riete groei
veranderings.na: lewe in die water, en riete groei
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.

veranderings.voor: Die see is baie groot en sy water is sout in plaas van vars
veranderings.na: Die see is baie groot, en sy water is sout, nie vars nie
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses, and 'sout, nie vars nie' is more natural Afrikaans than the English-shaped 'in plaas van vars'.

vlae.teks: Haaie, robbe en visse lewe in die see.
vlae.rede: Listing sharks beside fish may suggest sharks are not fish; a content question for the writer or fact check, not a language fix.
